lemmas.primary_translation: to make smooth; even out; reduce; downplay or soften

examples.no: han glatter over håret med hendene
examples.en: he smooths down his hair with his hands

definitions.text: gjøre strid, uenighet, motsetninger, forskjeller eller lignende mindre
definitions.translation: reduce disputes, disagreements, conflicts, differences, or the like

examples.no: hun prøvde å glatte over krangelen med latter
examples.en: she tried to smooth over the quarrel with laughter
